reversing_premises: That the selected-result line divided by 72 rather than 96, or otherwise restricted the exposure base to the retained subset
That the visible data supplied occurrence outcomes for the 24 omitted stations which were nonetheless excluded from the computation
That the report asserted the 0.1875 value as an unqualified point estimate of the true complete-network rate rather than an explicitly bounded lower-bound quantity
falsification_attempt.strongest_innocent_explanation: Inverting the usual direction, the strongest case for an in-scope issue would be that the numerator 18 is derived solely from the 72 retained stations while the denominator spans all 96, so the computation still 'uses only a retained subset' of the domain for the occurrence count and thereby understates the complete-domain rate. The innocent explanation that defeats this is that the complete-domain exposure base is fully retained, the 24 unobserved units are explicitly carried at zero observed occurrences, and the report bounds the claim as a lower bound and disclaims any screened-subset rate.
